prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 用药说明 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "药品名称" · longest unbreakable word 23px · one-line width 122px
  col 2: header "规格" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 113px
  col 3: header "用法用量" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 123px
  col 4: header "频次" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 71px
  col 5: header "注意事项" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 590px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 451px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 450px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者按药品查阅规格、用法用量、服用频次和注意事项。","reading":"读者先定位药品，再横向读取同一行的服药信息；比较不同药品时，也会纵向扫描对应列。注意事项较长，预计主导行高，可让其他列的适度换行利用同一行的空间。","groups":["药品名称和规格共同识别药品及包装。","用法用量和频次共同说明如何服用，应便于连续阅读。","注意事项是每种药品的补充说明，适合分配较宽的弹性空间。"],"keep_intact":["药品名称尽量完整，避免拆开字母、数字与药名的组合。","规格中的剂量、单位和数量应保持清晰，避免拆开数字与单位。","用法中的剂量、数量和频次中的数字单位组合应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["药品名称和规格可在自然边界换行。","用法用量可在逗号或语义边界换行。","注意事项可按语义自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [98, 82, 85, 55, 130] · table 451×514px · row heights [66, 171, 92, 92, 92] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [100, 85, 86, 60, 119] · table 451×567px · row heights [66, 197, 118, 118, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [98, 80, 80, 72, 120] · table 451×567px · row heights [66, 197, 118, 118, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"注意事项较宽，四条记录的说明相对容易阅读；规格中的数量和单位也较清楚。各行高度有变化，有助于反映内容多少。","problems":"用法用量和频次两个相邻表头都换行，削弱了表头层级；频次被拆成多行，纵向比较不顺畅。用法也显得拥挤。","cause":"用法用量列为85px，容不下完整表头；频次列为55px，表头和“每日3次”等内容都受到挤压。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"频次表头完整，频次内容较易逐列比较；药品名称和规格的分配较均衡，没有单词内部断裂。","problems":"用法用量表头仍换行；注意事项换行密集，前三条记录的行高明显增加，短内容列出现较多空白。","cause":"用法用量列为86px，仍不足以容纳完整表头；注意事项列缩到119px，使长说明增加到最多7行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"频次表头完整，频次列留有较充足的空间；药品名称可辨识，也没有单词内部断裂。","problems":"频次列相对宽裕，但内容仍有换行；用法用量表头换行，注意事项密集，前三条记录偏高，整体宽度分配不够有效。","cause":"频次列增至72px，占用了用法用量和注意事项可用的空间；后两列分别只有80px和120px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-refinement","widths":[95,78,90,60,127],"change":"以r1A为基础，为用法用量和频次表头增加空间，同时保留较宽的注意事项列；略收紧名称与规格，争取在表头完整和说明可读性之间取得平衡。"},{"name":"caution-priority","widths":[90,75,90,60,135],"change":"进一步增加注意事项宽度，检验能否减少长说明的换行和行高；名称与规格使用较紧凑的宽度，利用说明所形成的行高容纳自然换行。"},{"name":"name-priority","widths":[105,75,90,60,120],"change":"给药品名称更多空间，改善按药名定位时的辨识度；保持两个用药表头的空间，并检验较窄注意事项列带来的高度代价。"}]}
